HINDI MASTER EDUCATIONAL CORPUS — 5,000 EXAMPLES
============================================================

SOURCE FRAMEWORK
----------------
Expanded directly from the supplied six-language Grade 1–12 framework.
Coverage: literacy, pronunciation/phonetics, grammar, syntax, literature,
writing, morals/ethics, EVS, environmental awareness, civic responsibility,
and advanced composition.

SCRIPT / DIRECTION
------------------
Devanagari, left-to-right

STAGES
------
कक्षा १-५, कक्षा ६-८, कक्षा ९-१०, कक्षा ११-१२

CORPUS DESIGN
-------------
Each example contains:
1. Learning stage
2. Topic
3. Task/instruction
4. Target skill
5. Context
6. Expected response pattern
7. Grammar/linguistic focus
8. EVS/value connection
9. Difficulty progression
10. Evaluation checklist

Important: this is an expanded educational corpus generated from the supplied
framework. It is not a replacement for a specific board's official textbook
or syllabus.


EXAMPLE 0001
--------------
Language: Hindi
Stage: कक्षा १-५
Topic: रस
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
{topic} को पर्यावरण और जिम्मेदार नागरिकता से जोड़कर लिखिए।

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to रस. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in रस, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

EXAMPLE 0158
--------------
Language: Hindi
Stage: कक्षा १-५
Topic: सतत विकास
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
{topic} से मिलने वाली नैतिक शिक्षा समझाइए।

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to सतत विकास. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in सतत विकास, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in संज्ञा और सर्वनाम, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

--------------------------

• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;

• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Language: Hindi
Stage: कक्षा १-५
Topic: रस
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
{topic} से जुड़े वाक्य को दिए गए काल में बदलिए।

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to रस. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in रस, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

TASK
----

CONTEXT
-------

language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.

When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in समास, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;

Language: Hindi
Stage: कक्षा १-५
Topic: उपसर्ग और प्रत्यय
Difficulty: Foundational: recognition, tracing, simple vocabulary, short sentences

TASK
----
{topic} पर तीन प्रश्न और उनके उत्तर तैयार कीजिए।

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to उपसर्ग और प्रत्यय. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in उपसर्ग और प्रत्यय, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Hindi
Stage: कक्षा ६-८
Topic: मुहावरे
Difficulty: Structural: grammar application, prose comprehension, guided composition

TASK
----
{topic} के संबंध में औपचारिक पत्र लिखिए।

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to मुहावरे. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in मुहावरे, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

Language: Hindi
Stage: कक्षा ६-८
Topic: निबंध लेखन
Difficulty: Structural: grammar application, prose comprehension, guided composition

TASK
----
{topic} पर एक छोटा अनुच्छेद लिखिए।

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to निबंध लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in निबंध लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

EXAMPLE 2460
--------------
Language: Hindi
Stage: कक्षा ६-८
Topic: वाक्य-भेद
Difficulty: Structural: grammar application, prose comprehension, guided composition

TASK
----
{topic} से संबंधित वाक्य में दिए गए शब्द का व्याकरणिक पद बताइए।

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to वाक्य-भेद. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in वाक्य-भेद, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

Language: Hindi
Stage: कक्षा ९-१०
Topic: रिपोर्ट लेखन
Difficulty: Advanced school: syntax, rhetoric, analysis, formal writing

TASK
----
{topic} के संबंध में औपचारिक पत्र लिखिए।

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to रिपोर्ट लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in रिपोर्ट लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

------------------------------

Language: Hindi
Stage: कक्षा ९-१०
Topic: रिपोर्ट लेखन
Difficulty: Advanced school: syntax, rhetoric, analysis, formal writing

TASK
----
{topic} के संबंध में औपचारिक पत्र लिखिए।

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to रिपोर्ट लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in रिपोर्ट लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level

------------------------------

Language: Hindi
Stage: कक्षा ११-१२
Topic: पत्र लेखन
Difficulty: Higher secondary: stylistics, criticism, executive writing, synthesis

TASK
----
{topic} पर एक छोटा अनुच्छेद लिखिए।

CONTEXT
-------
Create a short, age-appropriate learning item related to पत्र लेखन. Keep the
language natural, coherent and consistent with the script used by this corpus.
When the task concerns grammar, make the grammatical target unambiguous.
When the task concerns literature or rhetoric, distinguish literal meaning
from interpretation.

TARGET SKILL
------------
Develop competence in पत्र लेखन, while connecting reading, writing, vocabulary,
grammar, comprehension, reasoning or communication as appropriate.

LINGUISTIC FOCUS
----------------
Identify the relevant unit: letter/sound, word, morphology, phrase, clause,
sentence, paragraph, discourse, literary device, register, or composition
structure. For advanced examples, include syntactic or rhetorical reasoning.

EVS / VALUE CONNECTION
----------------------
Where appropriate, connect the item with honesty, compassion, respect,
patience, gratitude, responsibility, environmental stewardship, water
conservation, biodiversity, sustainable development, civic duty, digital
ethics, human rights or community harmony. Do not force a moral lesson into
a purely mechanical grammar exercise.

EXPECTED RESPONSE PATTERN
--------------------------
A good response should:
• directly answer the task;
• use the target language and appropriate script;
• demonstrate the specified linguistic skill;
• preserve grammatical agreement and coherent meaning;
• use age-appropriate vocabulary for the stated stage;
• avoid unnecessary code-switching unless requested;
• distinguish fact, interpretation and opinion when relevant.

EVALUATION CHECKLIST
--------------------
[ ] Task understood
[ ] Correct script/direction
[ ] Appropriate vocabulary
[ ] Grammar target correctly demonstrated
[ ] Sentence/paragraph coherence
[ ] Correct punctuation where applicable
[ ] Appropriate register
[ ] EVS/value connection only where relevant
[ ] No unsupported factual claim
[ ] Response appropriate to grade level
